name: Ecosystem Survey
description: Study the Salt River ecosystem and collect biological evidence without disturbing the habitat.

steps.description: Observe the shallow-water food web and movement patterns.
Collect an algae sample from the riverbank.
Collect a microbial sample jar for lab observation.
Use river speed and fish swimming speed to reason about relative motion.

reward.label: Ecosystem survey
reward.childMessage: You gathered river evidence without breaking the habitat.
